## Goal

What single outcome does this change produce?

## Scope / non-goals

What changed, and what intentionally did not?

## Public contract

Describe any endpoint, parameter, response, category, level, OpenAPI, or documentation impact. Write `None` if there is no public contract change.

## Security impact

- [ ] No new secret or credential handling
- [ ] No new outbound network access
- [ ] No new persistence or user data
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
- [ ] Threat model updated if attack surface changed

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated when behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Public docs and OpenAPI updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Change is intentionally scoped and contains no unrelated cleanup
